title: Lead Economist, Editorial
industry: Economics, Macroeconomics and Monetary Economics (JEL E), Economics and Social Sciences, Data Science, Finance
text:
Opportunity
Wealthfront is looking for an economist or data scientist with macro expertise to produce public-facing economic research, data sets, and written content using first- and third-party data. This role will sit within Wealthfront’s Investment Research and Data Science team, and support the Wealthfront Content Team by providing insight into consumer, market, and business trends that helps young professionals connect macroeconomic news with their personal finance goals.
This role will particularly support our growing market commentary vertical and newsletter, Vested Interest, in addition to Wealthfront’s blog, social media channels, and media outreach. To bring content and analyses to life across channels, this role will work closely with multiple teams across the company including the Vested Interest team, Investment Research, Social Media, Blog, Creative, Compliance, and more.
Data Science at Wealthfront
The Wealthfront Data Science team utilizes our rich financial and behavioral data to influence Marketing, Product and information security decisions. The team draws from backgrounds in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics and Finance.
The Data Scientist in this role will be primarily embedded within Wealthfront’s Content Team, which focuses on inspiring and empowering smart financial decisions through original, timely content. Through this content, we aim to make Wealthfront the trusted partner for young professionals managing and growing wealth.
Responsibilities
Monitor market and macroeconomic news daily and generate timely, unique economic analyses that help young professionals navigate market trends and build their financial confidence.
Turn your analyses into public-facing written content, visualizations, and interactive tools that increase engagement with Wealthfront’s audience.
Partner with Comms, Social Media and Creative teams to distribute your work across a variety of content channels.
Conduct media, podcast, and video interviews to further publicize your analyses.
Support additional Research and Data Science initiatives as needed.
Qualifications
4-6+ years experience running quantitative economic data analyses and writing accessible, high-quality content summarizing your findings.
Experience analyzing third and first-party economic data and connecting it to consumer finance trends.
Storytelling creativity and expertise in translating data into unique, digestible content.
Experience with data visualization is highly preferred.
Willingness to participate in public facing media and/or video interviews required, previous experience preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in economics or another quantitative field required, Masters or PhD preferred.
Proficiency in high-level programming languages such as Python or R.
Estimated annual salary range: $185,000 - $211,000 plus equity and a discretionary bonus.
Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more!
About Wealthfront
Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money.
We started with the ambition to transform the investment advisory business. By automating strategies typically reserved for the wealthy, we unlocked access to high quality investment advice for a digitally-native generation that was underserved by traditional institutions. Since then, we've expanded to a full suite of products designed to help our clients turn their savings into long-term wealth, including:
A Cash Account that, through our partner banks, offers one of the highest annual percentage yields on uninvested cash in the industry, while providing instant and secure access to your money with no account fees and a full suite of checking features.
A zero-commission Stock Investing Account with 50+ handpicked collections that help DIY investors discover new companies and make smarter investing decisions.
Multiple automated investing portfolios designed to unlock tax savings through sophisticated strategies like fixed income, tax-loss harvesting, and direct indexing—which we offer at industry-leading low costs and accessible minimums.
Our award-winning products have attracted over 1 million clients who trust us with more than $100 billion of their hard earned savings—and we're far from done. If you’re inspired to help us reshape the financial industry as we create our next chapter, let’s talk!
